entities.name: High scores that can't be faked
entities.description: A score is listed only as the server's replay of the match computes it.
entities.behavior: The server issues the seed, the browser sends the player's recorded moves with a name and the computer's level, and the Worker replays the whole match with the same engine before storing the score the replay produced. Each seed enters once.
entities.outcome: Players can trust the table: a score cannot be typed in, edited or submitted twice.
constraints: Names of up to 12 characters, cleaned the same way as in the browser.
Only one-player matches against the computer.

entities.name: Public scores page
entities.description: The table as a page of icelander.net.
entities.behavior: The best 25 matches are listed with the name, score, the computer's level and the match's result, in the site's look, with inline styles so the strict content policy holds.
entities.outcome: Anyone can see the table without signing in or opening the game.

relatedViews.relationship: The capability these features belong to.
